subject: Media Literacy
title: Greenwashing
description: A quick, practical guide to Greenwashing.

hook.text: BP rebranded with a green flower logo and launched 'Beyond Petroleum' — while remaining a massive oil company.

buildup.text: Greenwashing is when companies advertise environmental responsibility they don't actually practice.

discovery.text: Common tactics include vague claims like 'eco-friendly,' green packaging, and cherry-picked sustainability data.

twist.text: The companies spending the most on green advertising are often the biggest environmental offenders.

climax.text: Greenwashing co-opts your environmental values to sell products that harm the planet.

punchline.text: Green packaging isn't green policy. Read past the label.

quiz.question: What is greenwashing?
options: Advertising environmental responsibility a company doesn't practice
